label: Citywide MHA
detail: Mandatory Housing Affordability takes effect citywide (Ord. 125791). It had applied to six areas since 2017.

label: ADU reform
detail: Two ADUs per lot; owner-occupancy and parking requirements removed (Ord. 125854, CB 119544).

label: Interim middle housing
detail: Interim middle-housing zoning for state HB 1110 takes effect (Ord. 127219, CB 120969).

label: Permanent middle housing
detail: Permanent middle-housing zoning takes effect (Ord. 127376, CB 120993).
